How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Delhi Consultant Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.iitd.ac.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 30-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Delhi Consultant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the IIT Delhi Consultant positions is 30th September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Consultant post at IIT Delhi?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Consultant position at the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi through this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Consultant role?
faq.answer: To be eligible, candidates need a Master's Degree with a minimum of 55% marks and 1 year of relevant experience, or a Bachelor's Degree with a minimum of 60% marks and 3 years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the Consultant position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Consultant post is 35 years as of the cut-off date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Consultant position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Consultant role will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 35,000/- to Rs. 50,000/-.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the IIT Delhi Consultant recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Consultant posts at IIT Delhi?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Consultant positions at IIT Delhi will involve shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the IIT Delhi Consultant job?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website, fill it correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it to the address mentioned in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment for the Consultant posts at IIT Delhi is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of IIT Delhi, www.iitd.ac.in. Links are also provided in the Important Links section of this article.
